info.title: Car Rental API
info.description: Foundation, catalog, reservations and availability APIs. Web and API share application actions. Permissions require both role and token ability. Dates accept ISO 8601 with explicit offset and seconds; stored UTC, agency dates use Africa/Algiers. Rental lifecycle and append-only ledger share Livewire application actions. Every new rental, lifecycle, ledger and photo write requires a body idempotency_key UUID: retry with the same actor, key and normalized payload; changed input returns 409 retry_mismatch. Lifecycle writes require current version. Monetary inputs are decimal DZD strings with up to two decimals; outputs are integer centimes. Phase 5 adds a role-scoped operational dashboard, self-profile editing with immutable staff usernames, private avatars, immutable numbered receipts and versioned bilingual contract data. Login continues to use email. Phase 6 adds completed maintenance records, private evidence and date/mileage reminders. Maintenance is recorded by Managers; agents see operational fields only and Manager/Finance can read costs, notes and evidence. Phase 7 provides expense recording/reversals/evidence and date-filtered management reports/CSV. All require finance.manage (role and token). Expense amounts are integer centimes in responses; input uses decimal DZD strings. Maintenance creates exactly one linked expense automatically, including migration of existing services.

get.description: Requires finance.manage for role and token. Inclusive agency dates, maximum 366 days. Revenue uses rental start; standalone cancellations use original charge effective date. Opening debt, drafts and deposits excluded from revenue. Net payment/refund collections use effective dates; deposit applications are not new collections. Expenses use incurred date including reversals. Actual rental hours end at return or now; eligible time is clipped to service/archival/now and excludes the union of maintenance/admin blocks truncated at release. Cleaning/preparation remain eligible. Missing service entry/handover, inconsistent overlaps or zero denominator produce null utilization. Counts include active/returned rentals by agreed start date. Contribution is not accounting profit.

type.description: Vehicle: insurance, inspection, registration, maintenance. Customer: identity, licence.

ReservationInput.description: Confirmed requires a vehicle. Updates require version and reason. Confirmed cannot become tentative; use cancellation. Current preparation setting is snapshotted on first confirmation, retained on edits. Missing mandatory scans/expiry dates or latest document expiry before return require a Manager override. Override is scoped to vehicle, exact period and document issues; changed period/vehicle/issues requires renewed authorization.

BlockInput.description: Null end means indefinite. Maintenance, administrative and emergency blocks require fleet.manage in addition to blocks.manage. Ordinary overlaps reject; emergency retains bookings and exposes conflicts.

RentalCreate.description: Confirmed reservation_id + reservation_version, or customer_id + vehicle_id + starts_at + ends_at for walk-in. Null allowance means unlimited. Daily rounds up 24h; weekly/monthly require whole 7/30-day periods unless Manager negotiated_total. Nonzero discounts/custom prices require pricing_reason. Agent discount maximum 10% of base; additional charges unaffected.

RentalInspectionInput.description: Company driver may be assigned at handover. Driver details, identity/licence scans and unexpired dates mandatory. Return allows debt and requires Manager reason if mileage decreases. Actual time cannot be future. Extra fees and early-return repricing are explicit.

RentalExtend.description: Uses saved rate snapshot, rechecks inventory and vehicle documents, appends agreement version and replaces base charge by reversal/new charge.

RentalCancel.description: Draft only. Releases allocation and reverses base charge, preserving payments as credit.

LedgerInput.description: Positive amount except reversal requires reverses_id. Real cashflow requires method. Refund/application/deposit refund/reversal require finance.manage; collection payments.collect; charge rentals.manage or finance.manage. Reversal links to one unreversed non-base entry. Cannot reverse reversals or create negative held funds/net payments. Refund <= collected cash; deposit application <=held and debt.

LedgerTotals.description: Deposits held separately; cash_payments excludes applied deposits. Debt=max(charges-payments,0); credit=max(payments-charges,0).

pricing.description: Snapshot of rates, basis, quantity, base/discount/total_cents, reason, half_up rounding.

avatar.description: Private JPEG/PNG, up to2MB, maximum4096×4096 pixels.

SelfProfileInput.description: Only the authenticated user is modified. username is prohibited. Empty optional text becomes null. Name/email changes do not change username or prior audit attribution. Login remains email-based.

money.description: Null without finance.manage. Integer centimes for outstanding, held, credit, revenue, collections and daily series. Zero means known zero. Revenue attributed to rental start; drafts and opening balances excluded. Collections use effective payment/refund/reversal dates. Deposits are never collections/revenue.

snapshot.description: Frozen agency/sample marker, transaction, customer name/ID, actor username, rental/reservation ID, corrected receipt number when applicable.

Receipt.description: Issued atomically when a ledger transaction is posted; GET never issues one. Refunds use REF, deposits/payment/reversal documents use REC. Series follows issuance year in Africa/Algiers. Reprints preserve all data.

vehicle_commitment_id.description: Optional existing maintenance block for the same vehicle; recording never releases it.

serviced_on.description: Not later than today in Africa/Algiers.

idempotency_key.description: Same actor and normalized payload replay one record; changed input returns 409 stale.
